decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core pipeline range that was publicly presented on the website, it fits the firm's stated expansion path and management is likely to continue it rather than admit a mistaken launch.

Even though it is more distant from the core offer, the firm visibly committed to it and can link it to existing metalworking and coating capabilities, which makes management inclined to persist while results could still be seen as developing.

This product sits outside the main pipeline business but was launched as part of a visible small public-space line, so sunk effort and the wish to justify diversification make management somewhat more likely to keep than to cut it.

Among the distant products, this is the easiest to discontinue because it is least central to the firm's core direction and likely carries lower product-specific sunk costs, so persistence is weaker once disappointing demand cannot be treated as temporary.
